title: Joseph buys the land in Egypt
description: During the severe famine, Joseph gathers all the silver in Egypt and Canaan in exchange for grain. When the money runs out, the people give up their livestock, and then they sell both themselves and their land to Pharaoh for bread and seed grain. In this way, Joseph buys all the land in Egypt for Pharaoh, except for the priests' land, and establishes a law that one-fifth of the harvest must go to Pharaoh. [ref:1 Mos 47:13-26|1. Mosebok 47:13-26]
